lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed across the visible flank. Posterior to the branchial region, these form a staggered lattice of approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal spot rows, most notably in the posterior portion of the visible flank, forming anchor points at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from light dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct distribution of high-contrast spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin, characterized by smaller diameter and higher density relative to the primary lateral pattern.
